rationale: The prior invoice INV-3221 matches on vendor, PO, amount and date window, but carries a distinct non-overlapping service period (Feb 2026 vs Mar 2026), so under clause 8.1 this is a legitimate monthly retainer charge, not a duplicate. Price matches the blanket PO exactly (clause 3), tax at the vendor's 7.5% recomputes to $360.00 exactly (clause 5), and no goods receipt is expected on a SERVICES PO (clause 1). Net payable $5,160.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
